parameters.help_en:
The video model. Valid values:
wan2.6-r2v-flash
parameters.name: video_model

parameters.help_en: The model feature parameters in JSON format. Example: "AudioEnable": false disables audio
parameters.help_zh:
模型功能参数，Json 格式。

 "AudioEnable": false 声音关闭
parameters.name: model_params

parameters.help_en: The task title. If not provided, a default title is automatically generated based on the date. The title can be up to 128 bytes in length and must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题。若不提供，根据日期自动生成默认title  长度不超过128字节  UTF8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The custom settings in JSON format. NotifyAddress specifies the callback for task completion, which supports Message Service (MNS) and HTTP callbacks
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置，Json 格式。其中：
NotifyAddress 为任务完成的回调，支持设置MNS回调以及Http回调
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip failed shots. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过失败分镜，默认为True
parameters.name: skip_failure_shot

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode for storyboard generation. Valid values:
FullPipeline: End-to-end generation, which includes storyboard generation and shot video generation.
StoryboardOnly: Storyboard generation only
parameters.help_zh:
故事板生成执行模式。取值为：
FullPipeline：全链路生成（包含故事板生成以及分镜视频生成）。
StoryboardOnly：仅生成故事板
parameters.name: exec_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retain the original dialogue during final video synthesis. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 成片合成时是否保留原对白，默认为True
parameters.name: keep_origin_dialogue

parameters.help_en: The script language. Valid values: cn and en
parameters.name: shot_prompt_lang
